name: Sentura Monitoring
description: Aggregated health endpoints for the Sentura platform: gateway uptime, per-employee status, provider availability, and a one-shot summary view. Subscribes to the model.usage diagnostic event to track recent provider activity and reads the agent-tenancy + cost stores for employee-level signals.

providerWindowMinutes.description: How many recent minutes of model.usage events count toward 'provider is healthy'. Defaults to 5 minutes.
